project.name: Ecommerce
project.description: Reusable browser checks for the local ecommerce storefront. [testops-key:ecommerce-platform]

suites.name: 00 — Platform Smoke
suites.description: Guest storefront availability and fatal-error smoke. [testops-key:00-platform-smoke]

cases.name: Homepage smoke
cases.description: Open the storefront homepage and verify its product category landmark.

suites.name: 10 — Catalog and Search
suites.description: Catalog, details, search, filters, sorting, and URL state. [testops-key:10-catalog-search]

cases.name: Catalog homepage
cases.description: Verify the storefront catalog entry point is visible.

suites.name: 20 — Authentication and Verification
suites.description: Login, verification, reset, logout, and protected routes. [testops-key:20-auth-verification]

cases.name: Valid login
cases.description: Credentialed login uses E2E_CUSTOMER_EMAIL and E2E_CUSTOMER_PASSWORD.

cases.name: Unverified account restriction
cases.description: The native ecommerce suite owns Mailpit and verification state.

suites.name: 30 — Cart and Checkout
suites.description: Selected-item, COD, QR, stock, and duplicate-submit checks. [testops-key:30-cart-checkout]

cases.name: Selected-item checkout
cases.description: Transactional selected-item and idempotency checks stay in native tests.

suites.name: 40 — Orders and Reviews
suites.description: Order history, cancellation, and review eligibility. [testops-key:40-orders-reviews]

cases.name: Order history
cases.description: Review seeded order history and detail navigation.

suites.name: 50 — Messaging
suites.description: Seller conversations, unread state, and reconnect behavior. [testops-key:50-messaging]

cases.name: Seller conversation
cases.description: Two-user WebSocket orchestration remains in native Playwright tests.

suites.name: 60 — Seller Workflows
suites.description: Seller dashboard, product management, and order processing. [testops-key:60-seller-workflows]

cases.name: Seller dashboard
cases.description: Seller fixture access and ownership checks.

suites.name: 70 — Administration
suites.description: Administrative catalog, user, category, and order controls. [testops-key:70-administration]

cases.name: Admin dashboard
cases.description: Administrator fixture access and permission boundary.

suites.name: 80 — Resilience and Accessibility
suites.description: Failure states, keyboard navigation, dialogs, mobile, and evidence safety. [testops-key:80-resilience-accessibility]

cases.name: Keyboard navigation smoke
cases.description: Use PRESS and focus assertions after the storefront accessibility pass.
